description: 3D printing material configuration. Edit this file to add/remove materials or adjust pricing. No code changes needed.

materials.label: PLA
materials.description: General-purpose filament. Easy to print, low warp, good for most parts.

materials.label: PETG
materials.description: Stronger and more durable than PLA. Good for functional parts, outdoor use, and higher temperatures.

materials.label: ABS
materials.description: Tough, heat-resistant plastic. Best for mechanical parts, enclosures, and automotive uses. Requires enclosed printer.

materials.label: TPU
materials.description: Flexible filament. Great for gaskets, bumpers, grips, and wearables.

materials.label: PC
materials.description: Extremely strong and impact-resistant. Requires high-temperature printing (260°C+). Best for engineering-grade parts.

materials.label: ASA
materials.description: UV-resistant alternative to ABS. Ideal for outdoor parts that need to withstand sunlight.

materials.label: Nylon (PA)
materials.description: Very strong, durable, and slightly flexible. Great for functional parts, gears, and living hinges.

materials.label: Carbon Fiber PLA
materials.description: PLA infused with carbon fibre. Stiffer and more dimensionally stable than standard PLA. Requires hardened nozzle.

materials.label: Wood-Filled PLA
materials.description: PLA blended with wood fibres. Looks and smells like wood when printed. Can be sanded and stained.

materials.label: Other (I'll describe it)
materials.description: Don't see the material or colour you need? Tell me what you're looking for and I'll source it.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Good balance of speed and quality

5.label: 5% (Light)
5.description: Minimal internal structure. Good for display pieces.

15.label: 15% (Standard+)
15.description: Recommended balance of strength and material use.

25.label: 25% (Very Strong)
25.description: Maximum strength. Best for load-bearing parts.
